GOV-F-004-S62.title: System-Wide Audit Logging Integration
GOV-F-004-S62.description: Integrate the audit logging service into all GPT and Claude execution paths including tool_router, Brain runner, GPTReader, and pipeline operations to ensure every operation is captured with trace continuity.

GOV-F-004-S63.title: Append-Only Enforcement at Database Layer
GOV-F-004-S63.description: Implement database-level safeguards (e.g., MongoDB schema rules, write constraints, or collection configuration) to prevent updates and deletes on audit log records, ensuring true append-only behavior independent of application logic.
